speaker: george_bryan
text: Eleven lines. A fair copy. They have asked which reading is current. I am on my way west, and I need the one they should have.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There are two. In the first the phrase is longer, and it explains itself. In the second it is cut, and the cut does the work. If you have a moment I can say why each of them—

speaker: george_bryan
text: I have not a moment for why. Which one is current?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The shorter. Take that. I will mark it, so the sheet cannot drift back into an essay.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A cross. Here. This is the one.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A cross is enough. I am gone. If you improve it after I leave, improve it on another paper. This one has to stay sure.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go. I will not put the second thought on this sheet.
